question: T Balasaraswati, who was a dancer and actress, used to perform which of the following classical dances of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is one of the oldest classical dance forms in India and is rooted in **Tamil Nadu.**
 
• This dance form is deeply connected to the **Natya Shastra**, an ancient Sanskrit text on performing arts written by **Bharata.**
 
• **T Balasaraswati** was an acclaimed dancer who brought global recognition to Bharatanatyam through her exceptional performances.
 
• It is characterized by intricate **footwork, hand gestures (mudras), facial expressions (abhinaya),** and rhythmic movements.
 
• Bharatanatyam is a form of storytelling and is often performed as an offering in **temples**, expressing devotion to deities such as **Lord Shiva and Vishnu.**
 
• It is widely regarded as a spiritual art form, and its themes often revolve around **bhakti (devotion), mythology, and ancient scriptures.**
 
• The costumes and jewelry used in Bharatanatyam performances are elaborate, enhancing its visual appeal and cultural significance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kathak**__

 __
 
• **Kathak** originated in northern India and is one of the eight classical dance forms of India.
 
• It is characterized by **rapid footwork, spins, and storytelling** through dance.
 
• **Mughal influence** introduced Persian elements to Kathak, blending Hindu and Islamic traditions.
 
• Kathak is often performed with **tabla and harmonium** accompaniment.
 
 
 
• **Odissi**__
 __
 
• **Odissi** is a classical dance form originating from **Odisha.**
 
• It is known for its fluid movements, sculpturesque poses, and expressions of **devotion to Lord Jagannath.**
 
• Odissi often incorporates themes from **Vaishnavism and Shaivism.**
 
 
 
• **Manipuri**__
 
 
• **Manipuri** is a classical dance form from **Manipur** in northeastern India.
 
• It is characterized by graceful movements and religious themes, often dedicated to **Lord Krishna and Radha.**
 
• Manipuri costumes include unique **circular skirts** and veils.
